flagged.evidence: The item calls “|M(x)|<sqrt{x} for every real x>=1” the historical Mertens conjecture. Its cited Odlyzko–te Riele paper formulates the conjecture as “|M(x)|<x^(1/2), x>1” (equation (1.3), p. 139). This changes the cited domain; moreover the item’s own dependencies give M(1)=mu(1)=1, making its >=1 version trivially false at x=1 rather than the historical statement disproved by the paper.
